dedupe_keys.name: catalogue sigloire fr storm and wind hazard datasets

description: catalogue.sigloire.fr: storm and wind hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.sigloire.fr. Coverage: the area served by catalogue.sigloire.fr. The listing groups 11 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about storm and wind hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Surface terrestre submergée lors de la tempête Xynthia sur le littoral; Tempête du 13 février 1972 sur les Pays-de-la-Loire; Orage du 22 août 2011 sur les Pays-de-la-Loire; Orage du 7 juillet 1977 sur les Pays-de-la-Loire. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
